title: GraveGain2DC
description: A 2.5D dark fantasy action roguelite with three temporal combat modes, a 10-mission campaign, endless procedural floors, hidden secret vaults, guarded treasure caches, 20 collectible weapons, persistent career progression, and the LuckyStarShip hub.

maker.name: Antigravity Dev
maker.bio: Specializing in high-fidelity HTML5 game experiences with immersive systems and rich game-feel.

keyboard.Focus: Focus the arena before using game keys; UI controls keep their own keyboard actions
keyboard.WASD / Mouse: Move with WASD; aim with the mouse
keyboard.Arrow Keys: Directional dodge in Realtime / Chrono; move one tile in Turn-Based
keyboard.Space: Dodge roll, or wait a turn in Turn-Based mode
keyboard.Left-Click: Fire your equipped weapon; each click uses one Turn-Based action
keyboard.V: Hold and release to charge melee; melee can break breachable walls; taps queue briefly near recovery, or strike during the guard flash to Shield Bash
keyboard.Right-Click: Timed block; a perfectly timed block counters an enemy with a guaranteed critical
keyboard.E: Interact with nearby doors, loot, and mission objects
keyboard.Q: Cycle through weapons found this run
keyboard.Shift: Sprint while moving in Realtime / Chrono
keyboard.G / K: Throw an explosive / shove nearby enemies in Realtime / Chrono
keyboard.1 / 2 / 3: Select Realtime, Chrono-Lock, or Turn-Based play from the game interface

touch.left side: Movement joystick; each Turn-Based gesture moves one tile
touch.floor: Tap or drag the right side to aim; quick taps also move in Realtime / Chrono when Tap-to-Move is enabled
touch.action runes: Hold Melee to charge a heavy swing; attack, Realtime / Chrono dodge, block, interact, race ability, and Turn-Based wait buttons
touch.bag: Equip weapons found during this run

gamepad.Left Stick: Move; in Turn-Based, tilt once in a direction to move one tile
gamepad.A: Select menus; dodge in Realtime / Chrono; wait in Turn-Based
gamepad.B: Hold and release to charge melee; one melee action in Turn-Based
gamepad.Left Bumper: Block; one guard action in Turn-Based

instructions: Choose a race, class, and temporal mode: Realtime, Chrono-Lock, or Turn-Based. In Turn-Based, each move, shot, guard, interaction, race ability, or wait advances the enemy turn. Hold and release V or Melee for a charged swing, break breachable walls with melee, ranged fire, or explosives, strike during the guard flash for a Shield Bash, and aim direct shots through humanoid weak spots for 2x critical headshots. Watch for violet seams that reveal breakable secret vaults and search corridor dead ends for chests; some caches are guarded. Finish standard enemies below 12% health and bosses below 5%. Play the 10-mission campaign or descend through endless procedural floors. Use the fog-of-war map to navigate, open the Bestiary from Pause to study foes, and collect weapon caches to build a run-specific arsenal of 20 weapons. Switch weapons with Q, then use class passives plus level-up relic drafts to shape your build. Gamepads navigate menus with the left stick or D-pad, A selects, and B backs out. In a run, use left stick to move, right stick to aim, RT to fire, A to dodge or wait, B to melee, X to interact, Y for ability, LB to block, RB to switch weapons, LT for explosives, and Start to pause. Find a Dungeon Duel opponent from the main menu for a five-minute kill-and-gold race; sign in when prompted. Track permanent combat, arsenal, campaign, and survival milestones in the Career Archive. Dodge the orange elite and red boss attack warnings; during Lucifer Hades' phase shifts, reach cyan Array Conduits and press E to overload them. Defeat every fifth-floor warden to unlock the descent. Bring Gold back to develop your LuckyStarShip through botany, exchange, repairs, and lore.
